text:
emma_am: Lighthouse wants to migrate a POC from CompetitorQ to Redwood. Key asks: pricing for ~10M tokens/mo, exact header passthrough for legacy auth, streaming framing compatibility (length-prefixed), JSON parity (stop trimming + key ordering), completed security questionnaire, and audit-grade per-request token logs. Can we triage blockers today?

raj_sol: I'll own pricing + framing. Pricing fits our mid-tier; propose a 30% POC credit to close. CompetitorQ uses 2-byte length-prefixed frames; our SSE/newline stream can be adapted by a thin adapter that prefixes lengths server-side. Need to benchmark for per-chunk latency (~5-30ms estimate).

nora_eng: Header passthrough: default is to drop cookies and sensitive headers. We support per-route allowlist preserve_headers=[...]. If they require Authorization passthrough across tenants, legal review needed. Regarding stop behavior, we stream raw tokens until stop; CompetitorQ strips the stop token and collapses trailing whitespace. I can add stop_strip=true and canonicalize_json=true flags at route level for parity.

sam_sec: Security: Data residency okay via Dedicated in eu-west or Private. Customer-managed KMS only on Private. Per-request logs exportable under NDA; retention and PII treatment must be defined. I'll prepare the questionnaire answers and flag items needing CISO/legal.

zoe_cs: Pinged Lighthouse for sample request/response pairs and their filled questionnaire. Asked them to list exact headers they require preserved (they mentioned X-Client-Id and X-Session-Sig) and their token rounding bucket. They want our answers by Friday EOD.

raj_sol: Billing rounding note: Lighthouse currently rounds per 8-token buckets. We can match rounding on the invoice generator; finance will need to produce a sample invoice PDF with per-route line items. Also they asked for per-request tokenization logs attached to invoices for auditors. That's doable under NDA.

nora_eng: Quick ingress snippet I'll test in staging: ```nginx
# preserve headers
proxy_set_header X-Preserve "x-client-id,x-session-sig,x-trace-id";
``` And frame adapter sketch: ```ts
while(chunk = readSSE()){ writeUInt16BE(chunk.length); write(chunk); }
``` I'll open a small PR for stop_strip + canonicalize_json flags.

infra-bot: infra-bot: staging namespace rwd-lighthouse-poc ready on rwd-staging-3. Ephemeral creds created at 1865432160, expire in 48h. Recommend tests: 1) length-prefixed stream smoke (20 prompts), 2) stop_strip parity (30 prompts), 3) header passthrough verification. Logs will be available at /var/presales/lighthouse for 24h.

sam_sec: I'll draft security responses (network, auth, KMS) and mark raw-body retention and Authorization passthrough as legal/CISO items. Zoe, please upload sample traffic so I can reference exact header names.

zoe_cs: Uploaded their questionnaire and sample traffic (redacted) to presales drive: https://redwood.app/drive/lighthouse/presales. Lighthouse confirmed X-Client-Id and X-Session-Sig are required and they accept the 30% trial credit.

emma_am: Action items: Raj - POC pricing + sample invoice. Nora - PR for frame adapter + stop_strip + canonicalize_json and run smoke. Sam - questionnaire draft and list legal gates. Zoe - confirm header names in doc and coordinate NDA. Need smoke results by tomorrow 11:00 so I can ship the SOW.

raj_sol: I'll prepare POC pricing and invoice PDF if smoke passes. ETA noon tomorrow.

nora_eng: Will push branch this afternoon and run the three smoke tests. Will post latency numbers and logs here.

sam_sec: Drafting questionnaire now, linking once ready.

zoe_cs: Noted. I'll track responses and make sure legal has the NDA request.

emma_am: Thanks team 680. Let's regroup after the smoke logs.
